name: Humiliation of Christ

phase_0.boundary_condition: The hypostatic union of divine and human natures in one person.

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state of the Word before the assumption of flesh.

TANCH.justification: The finality of the sacrificial act that closes the economy of salvation.

AFWD.justification: The forward movement from divine glory into the finite human condition.

AREV.justification: The self-emptying descent and voluntary relinquishment of status.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of the life of Christ toward the passion.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the divine subject in the suffering human form.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the subject into the path of physical death and the path of spiritual victory.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the person of Christ where death is swallowed up in life.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative alignment of the human will with the divine purpose.

EVALF.justification: The experience of abandonment and the negative weight of sin.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of total defeat and total victory held in one event.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible marks of the humiliation on the glorified body.

phase_3.void_description: The silence of the Father before the Word is spoken into history.
phase_3.true_description: The glorification of the Father through the submissive act of the Son.
phase_3.false_description: The descent into Hades and the reality of human mortality.
phase_3.both_description: The God-Man suffering on the tree as both victim and victor.

steps.domain_action: The Logos exists in the eternal silence of the Godhead.
The Word proceeds into the world through the incarnation.
The Son identifies himself with the human nature in the womb.
The earthly ministry links the birth to the appointed hour.
The voluntary descent begins through the washing of feet and the garden agony.
The person of Christ enters the crisis of the Passion.
The T-arm follows the path of perfect obedience to the Father.
The sentence of death is recorded and executed on the physical body.
The F-arm experiences the descent into the darkness of the grave.
The reverse morphism of death reaches its maximum depth in the tomb.
The state of the dead Christ holds both mortality and divinity in tension.
The Resurrection reunites the separated elements into a single glorified life.
The risen Christ identifies himself to the disciples by his wounds.
The marks of the humiliation are fixed eternally in the divine life.
The ascension completes the cycle and seals the work of redemption.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit who effects the union of natures and the efficacy of the sacrifice.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The communicatio idiomatum where properties of both natures are predicated of the one person.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Sacred Tradition and the liturgy which preserve the record of the humiliation.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The fullness of time which dictates the precise moment of the kenotic event.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Holy Scriptures as the primary witness to the life and death of Christ.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The finite suffering and temporal life of the incarnate Word.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Divine glory in isolation from the created order.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Divine glory inclusive of the redeemed human nature.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The loss of life is perfectly balanced by the gain of eternal life in the resurrection.
